t.7722-84-1.agn: The classification is for the concentrated solution (listed as 'hydrogen peroxide solution … %'); for the diluted solutions in household products the statement on the label depends on the concentration. It is a strong oxidiser (H271).
t.7722-84-1.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 008-003-00-9 (CLP00): Ox. Liq. 1, Acute Tox. 4 (Inhalation)*, Acute Tox. 4 (Oral)*, Skin Corr. 1A.
t.7722-84-1.summary: An oxygen-based bleach and disinfectant; breaks down into water and oxygen.
t.7722-84-1.what: Whitens stains by oxidising them and kills germs.
t.tem.h.H271: H271 May cause fire or explosion; strong oxidiser.
